verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated sandbox or test-environment feature. Users can build their own isolation by spinning up a separate cloud workspace in under a minute or running a separate self-hosted instance with one Docker Compose command. App developers also get a CLI `dev` mode that live-syncs changes. The API playground, however, explicitly runs real calls against your data, so it is not a sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox or staging workspace, a way to clone or seed production data into a test environment, guidance on isolating agent and API testing from production, and independent corroboration.
